sections.Intro: This is a very useful remedy in cases of catarrhal conditions, especially of the nose and throat. It is indicated in children with enlarged tonsils and adenoids. There is a general tendency to take cold easily.
sections.Nose: Chronic catarrh of the nose. Obstruction of the nose. Sneezing.
sections.Throat: Enlarged tonsils and adenoids. Throat feels swollen and sore. Hawking of mucus.
sections.Ears: Deafness from catarrh of the Eustachian tube. Otorrhoea.
